title: Using a detection template as a probe design reference
prerequisites: a template you have read, not merely run
an authorised target and a bounded request budget
excerpt: A community template encodes what a detector believes proves a condition: the request shape, the matcher, and the negative case. Read the matcher before using it, because a template that matches a reflected string proves reflection rather than the condition it names. The template is a hypothesis generator; the probe you run must still carry its own control.
